mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_file( user_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_url, knowledge_id, create_time, update_time ) values( #{userId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileUrl}, #{knowledgeId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: select id, user_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_url, knowledge_id, status, create_time, update_time FROM knowledge_file where knowledge_id=#{knowledgeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_file SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
